svg.desc: SLAP2 glutamate: stored green iGluSnFR4f dFF series, native a.u., without additional scaling. A/B: mouse 828408, November 18 2025, one standard-oddball session. 134 original sources; 119 eligible (DMD1 79, DMD2 40), pooled across DMDs. Both signals use the identical frozen archive-wide glutamate High/Intermediate-SNR selection, not calcium-specific SNR. Fifteen no-baseline-noise sources excluded. Protocol-clean 90-degree trials: 30 context/68 control. Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials: DMD1 28 context/59 control; DMD2 28 context/38 control. Acquisition segments split at gaps >3 median native frame intervals; each statistical window and the full displayed window must fit recorded segments. Finite eligible-source native coverage is required in both channels, including interpolation bracketing frames. Stored NaN warm-up frames are not filled. No interpolation across acquisition pauses. Trial exposure differs across DMDs, but matches between signals within each DMD. A: separately selected positive-joint (both MI>0.1) and active Q2-nonsignificant examples: DMD2:9, DMD1:35. No amplitude gate. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not necessarily visually unresponsive. Context trial heatmaps; context green/control grey means ± trial SEM. B: all eligible context sources grouped by DMD1 then DMD2, with labels and a divider. Within each DMD retain the relative order from the frozen context-glutamate Rastermap fit, shared with calcium; no refitting or trace normalization. Context/control curves: solid positive-joint (both MI>0.1) sources, dotted Q2-nonsignificant sources, each classified independently per channel. Means equally weight sources; SEM is across sources, not mice or independent neurons. Sources may belong to the same dendrite/cell. All displays subtract each trial's full native preceding-grey mean. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon Q1 compares native 500-ms oddball and preceding-standard means; unpaired two-sided Mann-Whitney Q2 compares context/control response minus preceding grey. Exploratory raw p<0.05 and |MI|>0.1; solid/example responsive rule: positive-joint (both MI>0.1). Signed MIs are not clipped. BH alternatives use all 134 original sources per event/channel. No glutamate event detection, spike conversion or smoothing kernel. Linear 200-Hz alignment is display-only; tests use original native frames. Tan/grey shading shows actual median preceding-standard/oddball presentation bounds {'comparison': [-0.7000000001862645, -0.35700000018618994], 'response': [0.0, 0.3430000000000746]}, not the 500-ms test windows. X-limits -0.75 to +0.75 s. C: verified standard glutamate subset, 2 sessions/2 mice, November 18 828408 and December 11 829704. DMD1 and DMD2 Q1/Q2/Both proportions include either MI sign; no amplitude gate. Include session/groups with >=20 eligible sources before testability. Denominator: eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable source/session observations, not unique independent neurons. Heights pool counts, not session percentage means. Circle/square points show mice 828408/829704, respectively. No bootstrap confidence intervals for two mice. Six frozen-QC sessions contain other protocols, twelve legacy sessions have unresolved standard block/event mapping, and four newer standard sessions lack frozen labels; none are silently called nonresponsive. Native trial coverage matches the existing dual-channel reference definition; red frames are consulted for completeness only, not glutamate statistics. DMD1: 110 jointly testable/110 eligible; Q1 29, Q2 19, Both 10. DMD2: 85 jointly testable/85 eligible; Q1 18, Q2 10, Both 4. Heatmap limits: A ±4, B ±1; rounded 99th absolute percentiles, blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar. Population curves include 7 positive-joint and 95 Q2-nonsignificant sources.
